title: City View! 0.7 Miles From Downtown!
description:
Welcome to Mercury View Lofts - Modern, spacious condos in the heart of the Gulch. 

• Walkable to restaurants, coffee shops, & shopping
•  Gym access by request - OFFSITE at our sister property just 0.2 miles away. 
• Free Wi-Fi
• Washer & Dryer in-unit
• Full Kitchen
• This unit unavailable? Check out more Mercury View Lofts here: https://www.airbnb. com/wishlists/139123140
• Public Parking onsite starting at $45/day with in and out privileges

The space
Working remotely in Nashville? We’d love to host you! Whether you’re in town for a work trip, an extended project, or simply want a change of scenery, our space offers a comfortable home base while you work and explore Nashville. Staying longer? Reach out to inquire about extended-stay options—we’d be happy to accommodate your work trip!

Located in the heart of the Gulch in downtown Nashville, Mercury View Lofts is exactly where you want to be to take advantage of all that the Music City has to offer. This unit's big, open windows give you optimum viewing of our city's beautiful downtown, including a perfect visual of Nashville's famous "Batman" building. Watch the sunrise over the city in the morning, and gaze out over the city lights at night! 

Situated directly across the street from Nashville’s iconic Station Inn, the lofts are walking distance to a variety of restaurants and nightlife and just six blocks to the Music City Center. Continue just two blocks further to enjoy the nightlife on Broadway. The loft’s convenient location will allow you to leave your car at home and explore the city on foot.

When you are spending time in the loft, we have made every effort to make sure you feel at home. This loft features 15ft ceilings and huge windows looking out onto Nashville and the vibrant Gulch neighborhood. The loft has 2 bedrooms in an open concept setting. One bedroom is exposed to the living area and kitchen while the 2nd is tucked away. There 1 king bed and 1 queen bed as well as a sleeper sofa with a memory foam mattress in the living room that provides a third sleeping spot if it is needed. We offer a SmartTV with all streaming capabilities (NO cable), high-speed Wi-Fi, and a washing machine and dryer in your unit!

PARKING: Parking starts at $45/night in the public lot onsite - if staying 5 or more nights, please inquire about discounted parking options!

Gym access by request - OFFSITE at our sister property just 0.2 miles away. Please request from the hours of 8:30am - 5pm. All requests after 5pm will be handled the next business day! 

Please note, the unit has an industrial open piping structure, which has the potential for more noise when the AC/Heat kicks on. If you are sensitive to that type of noise, let our team know! We do provide a sound machines in the bedroom, but are happy to provide ear plugs if needed as well.

Guest access
Guests have full access to the entire unit during their stay as well as the shared patio hall space on the third floor.  Prior to your arrival, you will receive a unique keypad code that will serve as your keys to the property. You will have a code to enter the building and a code for your unit.

Gym access by request - OFFSITE at our sister property just 0.2 miles away.

PARKING: Parking starts at $45/night in the public lot onsite - if staying 5 or more nights, please inquire about discounted parking options!

Other things to note
→ Our nightly minimum varies depending on the time of year and day of the week. Refer to our calendar for the most up to date availability and feel free to message us with any questions. 

→ If this unit isn't available, we have other Mercury View lofts! Check them out here: https://www.airbnb. com/wishlists/139123140

→ Still not finding what you're looking for? Check out more of our properties here: https://www.airbnb. com/users/show/6855810

→ Check-in is at 4 pm // Check out is at 10 am. If you're looking to check in early or check out late, we suggest booking the night before or after your arrival. Otherwise, to be considerate to other guests, we cannot guarantee that early check-in or late check-out request will be accommodated. Feel free to arrive anytime after 4 pm.

→  Entry: You will have keys to the unit. You will receive two codes before check-in via email - one for the building access and one to the lockbox at the unit door. 

→ PARKING: Parking starts at $45/night in the public lot onsite - if staying 5 or more nights, please inquire about discounted parking options!

→ Gym Access is available by request only and must be requested 24 hours before your arrival. If requested within 24 hours of your arrival, fob access may not be granted until one day after your arrival. The Gym is located at our sister property about a 5-10 minute walk away. The gym is open 24/7. You must be 21 years or older to access the gym.

→  Regarding the unit: Max occupancy is 6 people. There are a dishwasher and icemaker. Laundry is in the unit. There is a king bed, queen bed, & a sofa bed. Note that the bedroom is NOT separated by a door to the living room. Towels & linen are provided (including linen & pillows for the sofa bed). Travel-sized toiletries, a hairdryer, iron, and ironing board are provided. A drip coffee maker and basic kitchenware are also provided. Guests are responsible to provide any additional amenities desired such as additional toilet paper.  Feel free to use our record player, note that UN does not provide a speaker however guests are welcome to connect their own Bluetooth speakers or devices! That said please be mindful of our quiet hours of 10pm to 8am. 

→ There is NO cable, but there is a Smart TV with all streaming capabilities

→After placing your booking you will receive a text from our team with a link to sign a form to confirm you've reviewed our house rules and ensure the check-in process go smoothly. We will send access info one day prior to arrival, if booking same day, you may call our team as soon as you've booked. Please ensure your number on your Airbnb profile is up to date.

→ Rest assured, our team is around 24/7 for any emergency that may arise.

→ The permit # can be found in the listing captions.
